meta.title: Las Vegas Activities (<=1h Public Transit), Transit Fares & Combined 7-Night Couple Budgets

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.zone: Center Strip (3600 S Las Vegas Blvd)
activities.hours: Mon–Fri: every 30 min 3:00 PM – 6:30 PM, every 15 min 7:00 PM – 12:00 AM; Sat, Sun & Holidays: every 30 min 12:00 PM – 6:30 PM, every 15 min 7:00 PM – 12:00 AM (verify 6:30 vs 7:30 PM transition on Bellagio MGM page; schedule subject to wind)
activities.transit_from_center_strip: 0–8 min walk; RTC Deuce Bellagio stop
activities.notes: Zero-cost centerpiece walk from Caesars Palace, Horseshoe, Paris, Planet Hollywood, Flamingo, and Cosmopolitan.

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience (Viva Vision Canopy & Concerts)
activities.hours: Viva Vision canopy light shows hourly 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM nightly; free live stages nightly
activities.transit_from_center_strip: ~28–38 min est. via 24h RTC Deuce Northbound (or 2 min walk from Downtown Grand)
activities.notes: AUDIT FIX (RA-11): Canonical activities.json listed 3 verified YouTube URLs (incl. official @vegasfremontstreet KDARquYGk_M) while simultaneously stating 'no YouTube link is published' in social_caveat.

activities.name: The Neon Museum (Neon Boneyard)
activities.zone: Downtown North (770 Las Vegas Blvd N)
activities.hours: 2027 Admission (Sep 1 – Apr 30 schedule): Daily 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (last entry 10:00 PM)
activities.price_2_adults: From $42.00+ ($21.00+/adult General Admission; Brilliant! Jackpot & guided night tours higher)
activities.transit_from_center_strip: ~35–45 min est. via 24h RTC Deuce Northbound (Las Vegas Blvd N / Cashman stop)
activities.notes: Verified directly on neonmuseum.org/visit/ ('2027 Admission: Open Daily, 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM', adult GA from $21). Also corrects RA-11 social_caveat contradiction.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel at The LINQ Promenade
activities.zone: Center Strip (3545 S Las Vegas Blvd)
activities.transit_from_center_strip: 0 min from The LINQ / Harrah's / Flamingo; Harrah's/The LINQ Monorail Station at base
activities.notes: HOURS LEFT BLANK (F-63 / FL-04): Official Caesars page contradicts itself on the same URL ('12:00 PM – 12:00 AM daily' vs 'Mon–Thu 12:30 PM – 11:30 PM, Fri–Sun 12:30 PM – 12:30 AM'). Daytime ($23.50/pp = $47.00 couple, valid before 5 PM) & Anytime ($34.75/pp = $69.50 couple) base prices verified on Caesars page before Ticketmaster checkout fees.

activities.name: The Mob Museum (National Museum of Organized Crime & Law Enforcement)
activities.hours: Museum: Daily 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM. The Underground speakeasy: Sun–Thu 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM; Fri–Sat 11:00 AM – 12:00 AM
activities.transit_from_center_strip: ~30–40 min est. via 24h RTC Deuce Northbound (2 min walk from Downtown Grand)
activities.notes: Verified directly on themobmuseum.org ($37.95 General Admission × 2 = $75.90; Premier/Deluxe Pass bundles extra).

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas (The Sphere Experience / Concerts)
activities.zone: East of Venetian / Palazzo (255 Sands Ave)
activities.hours: Varies by showtime (doors typically 45–60 min prior)
activities.transit_from_center_strip: 10–15 min walk via Venetian pedestrian bridge or Harrah's/The LINQ Monorail Station
activities.notes: PRICE LEFT BLANK (FL-06): Dynamic demand-priced ticketing by event/seat on Ticketmaster; Feb–Mar 2027 residency/film calendar must be checked directly on thesphere.com.

transit_systems.name: RTC Strip & All-Access Bus (The Deuce + All Residential Routes incl. 203 & 202)
transit_systems.mode_type: Public Municipal Bus (24/7 on The Deuce)
transit_systems.corridors: Runs 24/7 along the entire Las Vegas Strip (Mandalay Bay <-> Center Strip <-> Venetian/Wynn/Resorts World/Fontainebleau/SAHARA <-> Arts District <-> Fremont/Downtown), AND includes transfers onto Route 203 (Spring Mountain/Chinatown) and Route 202 (Flamingo Rd/Ping Pang Pong).
transit_systems.fares_2_adults_7_nights: $88.00 for 2 adults over 7 days (2× 3-Day Passes @ $20 + 1× 24-Hour Pass @ $8 = $48/person × 2 = $96.00; or 2× 3-Day Passes + 1 single ride = $44/person × 2 = $88.00; or 3× 3-Day Passes covering 9 days = $60/person × 2 = $120.00)
transit_systems.audit_note: AUDIT FIX (RA-02 & RA-12): Orphan canonical costs.html still prints '$6.00' instead of '$120.00' for 3× 3-day passes, and canonical transit.json states 'Nevada local fares are $1' whereas RTC's official regular residential single ride is $2.00 ($1.00 is Reduced Fare only).

transit_systems.name: RTC Route 203 — Spring Mountain / Desert Inn / Lamb (Chinatown MICHELIN Spine)
transit_systems.corridors: Connects Fashion Show / Wynn / Treasure Island / Harrah's-LINQ walk (Las Vegas Blvd & Spring Mountain Rd) directly west along Spring Mountain Rd to Pho Ga Bac Bac, KAME Omakase, Partage, Sparrow + Wolf, Lamaii, and Kabuto (~15–22 min bus ride).
transit_systems.fares_per_person: Covered by any Strip & All-Access Pass; standalone Residential Regular fare is $2.00 single ride / $3.00 2-hour / $5.00 24-hour / $20.00 7-day Residential Pass ($1.00 Reduced Fare only for eligible seniors/youth/disabled/veterans)
transit_systems.fares_2_adults_7_nights: $0.00 incremental when holding Strip & All-Access Passes (or $40.00/couple for two 7-Day Residential Passes if only riding residential buses — note Residential passes are NOT valid on The Deuce!)
transit_systems.audit_note: Official PDF schedule verified directly from rtcsnv.com/ways-to-travel/schedules-maps/.

transit_systems.name: Las Vegas Monorail (7 East-Strip Stations)
transit_systems.corridors: SAHARA <-> Westgate <-> Boingo/LVCC <-> Harrah's/The LINQ <-> Flamingo/Caesars Palace <-> Horseshoe/Paris <-> MGM Grand (end-to-end ~15 min).
transit_systems.fares_2_adults_7_nights: $119.90 for 2 adults (2 × $59.95 7-Day Unlimited Mobile Pass; or $22.00 for 2 round-trip rides to MGM Grand for Joël Robuchon / L'Atelier)
transit_systems.audit_note: Fastest congestion-free link from Center Strip (LINQ, Flamingo, Horseshoe, Paris, Harrah's) to MGM Grand's 2★ Joël Robuchon & 1★ L'Atelier.

transit_systems.name: Vegas Loop (The Boring Company — 14 Active Stations)
transit_systems.mode_type: Point-to-Point Underground Tunnel EV (NOT Public Bus/Subway)
transit_systems.corridors: AUDIT FIX (RA-12): Official boringcompany.com/projects/las-vegas-loop lists 14 active stations (canonical transit.json listed only 7): LVCC South, Central, West, Riviera, Central Plaza + Resorts World, Encore, Westgate, Fontainebleau, Sahara, Turnberry Towers, Virgin Hotels, Airport T1, and Airport T3.
transit_systems.fares_per_person: Official sample fares: $5.00 (LVCC <-> Strip Resorts: Resorts World / Encore / Westgate), $8.00 (LVCC <-> Thomas & Mack), $12.00 (Airport <-> LVCC); free within LVCC.
transit_systems.fares_2_adults_7_nights: Optional pay-per-ride supplement ($5/ride per vehicle/ticket segment); NOT counted toward public bus/rail <=1h eligibility.
transit_systems.audit_note: Helpful supplement if staying at Fontainebleau, Resorts World, or Encore, but RTC Deuce + Monorail remain the primary public transit backbone.
